about: One invented night staged by the learned sleep stage model as a platform without Core ML runs it: the trees in android/app/src/main/assets/sleepstage read as text. Written by SleepStageTreesTests (SLEEP_STAGE_ORACLE_WRITE=1); the Swift and the Kotlin test both read it. Streams hold one entry a second from 'from', null where there is no sample; gravity is in 1/scale g; a beat interval is 'at' seconds after 'from' and 'ms' long. Probabilities are in stageOrder. firstInput and neighbours are given for sampleEpochs only: the first model's whole row, and the columns the second model's row adds to it.
